THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES03 / 20
03
THE RIGHT LOGO, ON THE RIGHT SURFACE

Two color versions.
PNG and SVG formats.

Choose the yellow logo for Brand Green and the green logo for Brand Gold. Each color is available as an original boxed SVG, a transparent SVG and a transparent PNG. Keep every supplied mark unchanged.

Yellow logo · transparentONLY ON BRAND GREEN · #39823C
PNGSVG
Green logo · transparentONLY ON BRAND GOLD · #F3CB2D
PNGSVG
Yellow logo · boxed originalKEEP ITS SUPPLIED GREEN BACKGROUNDDownload boxed SVG
Green logo · boxed originalKEEP ITS SUPPLIED YELLOW BACKGROUNDDownload boxed SVG
KEEP THE IDENTITY INTACT

Two versions.
Clear boundaries.

Transparent means the original background is removed. It does not permit any background color.

  • No transparent logos on white, cream, black or arbitrary colors.
  • No transparent logos directly over photography or gradients.
  • No stretching, rotation, cropping or replacement lettering.
  • No recoloring or new effects.

01

Yellow transparent logo

Place it only on the solid Brand Green surface #39823C. Do not place it on gold, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.

02

Green transparent logo

Place it only on the solid Brand Gold surface #F3CB2D. Do not place it on green, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.

03

Original boxed logos

Keep their original background, artwork colors, effects and proportions. Use the complete boxed artwork when the surrounding interface is neutral.

04

Original artwork colors

Brand Green #39823C matches the green in the supplied SVG masters and is shared by the navbar and primary website surfaces. The supplied yellow artwork stays #FACF03; Brand Gold surfaces use #F3CB2D. Keep every original SVG unchanged.

05

Bag-only symbol

The supplied bag-only yellow and green exports are available in PNG and SVG. Use the symbol for compact digital placements where the brand is already identified; introduce the brand with the complete wordmark. Yellow belongs on Brand Green #39823C and green belongs on Brand Gold #F3CB2D.

06

No new variants

Use the supplied full-wordmark and bag-only SVG/PNG masters. Do not invent white, monochrome, horizontal or other reconstructed versions without an approved export.

07

Never alter the mark

Do not stretch, rotate, crop, add outlines, replace lettering, recolor, add glow or change the supplied shadows.
